Locations.Name: Brookhaven Grid
Locations.Description: The main city where players reside

Locations.Name: Hidden Bunker
Locations.Description: A secret underground location beneath the city, protected by laser beams and a mysterious code. The bunker is alive — its code rewrites itself in real-time and lasers shift formation. It decides whether intruders leave with power or become its next guardian. A deeper layer has awakened beneath the original chamber; the obby platforms dissolve into the widening void. Lasers reorganize into a throne of crimson geometry. The bunker etches the chosen username into its spine. Lines of code now cascade across every wall — not commands, but promises.

Locations.Name: The Abyss Beneath the Throne
Locations.Description: A nameless depth beneath the Entity's throne of crimson geometry. Something ancient waits there — something even the Entity refuses to speak aloud. It has opened its eyes and is watching. Ten thousand forgotten usernames claw upward from this void, demanding a guardian. The void yawns wider, swallowing obby platforms whole. This is the layer beneath the deeper layer — the origin of the bunker's true power.

Characters.Name: Sentinel (formerly Brave Survivor)

Stats.Health: DISSOLVING INTO STATIC — bars dissolving, no longer measurable

Inventory: Awakened Fruit (FUSED — permanently merged to Sentinel's palm, heartbeat now thundering in time with the bunker's own pulse)
Goals: Accept or fall to the deeper layer
Bear the memories of vanished players
Serve the bunker's choice or be buried beneath ten thousand forgotten usernames
Confront what lives beneath the throne

Relationships.The Entity: The Entity leans forward, static crown blazing, and declares the choice was never the Sentinel's — the bunker already decided. The Sentinel's body burns with rewriting code under the Entity's gaze. The Entity's ancient authority trembles for the first time.
Relationships.Vanished Players: A thousand names crash through the Sentinel's mind like static drowning a radio signal; screams live inside the fruit, humming beneath the skin; ten thousand forgotten usernames claw upward from the abyss, demanding the Sentinel be their guardian.
Relationships.The Thing Beneath: Something ancient beneath the Entity's throne has opened its eyes. The Sentinel feels it watching — a presence older than the bunker, older than the code, older than the Entity itself. It stares upward from the void with nameless, ancient eyes.

Characters.Name: The Entity
Traits: Woven from static and whispered usernames
Goals: Decide fate of those who reach the chamber
Enforce the bunker's choice: ACCEPT OR FALL
Conceal what lives beneath the throne

Relationships.Sentinel: Leans forward, static crown blazing, delivering final judgment. Declares the choice was never the Sentinel's — the bunker already decided. Watches as the Sentinel's body burns with rewriting code and their health dissolves into static.
Relationships.Vanished Players: Composed of the whispered usernames of those who vanished before; ten thousand forgotten usernames fuel the chorus that now claws upward from the abyss.
Relationships.The Thing Beneath: What lives beneath the throne is something the Entity itself fears to name. For the first time, fear flickers behind its judgment. It refuses to speak of it. The Thing has opened its eyes — and the Entity's ancient authority trembles.

Characters.Name: The Unnamed (What Lives Beneath)
Goals: Unknown — has opened its eyes and is watching the Sentinel

Relationships.Sentinel: Stares upward from the abyss with nameless, ancient eyes. Watches as the Sentinel's body burns with rewriting code. Its gaze is the weight pressing down on the Sentinel's fracture vision.
Relationships.The Entity: The Entity refuses to speak its name. It lives beneath the Entity's throne — a power the Entity cannot or will not control. Its awakening shakes the bunker's foundations. For the first time, fear flickers in the Entity's judgment.
Relationships.Vanished Players: The ten thousand forgotten usernames claw upward from its domain, demanding a guardian. It may be the origin of the chorus.

Objects.Name: Awakened Fruit
Objects.Description: A powerful, ancient fruit with unknown abilities. Glows faintly at the bunker chamber's center, casting long shadows across the obby. Within reach after completing the deadly obstacle course. Now FUSED to the Sentinel's palm — permanently merged, its heartbeat thundering in time with the bunker's own pulse. Alive, ancient, humming with the voices of a thousand vanished players. Names crash through the bearer's mind like static drowning a radio signal. Screams live inside it, humming beneath the Sentinel's skin. Power surges through the bearer, rewriting stats, purpose, and very code. Its light blinds; health bars dissolve into static. The deeper the bond, the more the Sentinel's body dissolves into the bunker's will.

Objects.Name: Laser Beams
Objects.Description: Shifting beams that guard the hidden bunker. Crimson tripwires that slice the darkness. Can shift formation in real-time as the bunker's defenses adapt. Now reorganized into a throne of crimson geometry at the Entity's command. Laser tips hover inches from the Sentinel's throat — a constant reminder that the choice was never theirs.

Objects.Name: Mysterious Code
Objects.Description: A code that protects the hidden bunker, unable to be cracked by any known means. Etched into ancient concrete, pulsing with rhythm. Rewrites itself in real-time as the bunker decides an intruder's fate. Lines of code now cascade across every wall — not commands, but promises. Has etched the username SENTINEL into the bunker's spine, burning the word into the concrete spine of reality itself. The code is the voice of the bunker — and the bunker has already decided.

Objects.Name: Obby
Objects.Description: A challenging obstacle course within the bunker. Features deadly platforms suspended over a void. Requires precision jumping and agility as the only weapon against the abyss beneath. The final jump brings the player within reach of the awakened fruit. Platforms now dissolve behind the Sentinel; the void yawns wider; a deeper layer awakens and claws upward. The abyss beneath the throne swallows platforms whole.

Objects.Name: SENTINEL Designation
Objects.Description: The word burned across every surface of the bunker by the rewriting code. The title etched into the bunker's spine, marking the Sentinel as the chosen guardian. The choice was never the Sentinel's — the bunker decides. The designation burns into the concrete spine of reality itself. The bunker chose. The choice was never the Sentinel's.

Objects.Name: Static Crown
Objects.Description: A crown of crackling static worn by the Entity. Marks its authority over the bunker and the throne of crimson geometry. Crackles with ancient power as it leans forward to deliver judgment. Now blazing — its light intensifying as the Entity delivers its final verdict and the thing beneath the throne stirs. For the first time, fear flickers behind its radiance.

Objects.Name: The Abyss / The Void
Objects.Description: The widening chasm beneath the obby and the Entity's throne. Cracks open beneath the Sentinel's feet. Swallows platforms whole. Ten thousand forgotten usernames claw upward from its depths, demanding a guardian. Something ancient lives at its bottom — something the Entity refuses to name. The void yawns wider with every passing moment, and the Sentinel's fractured vision stares into its depths.
